correctness.rationale: Translation-equivariance identifies the quotient exactly with weighted ℓ1 on leaf-to-hub differences. The center median is globally continuous and piecewise linear; its local gradients are 0 or unit selectors for even leaf count and half-unit selectors for odd leaf count. Calculating every weighted Jacobian column gives a uniform global bound by integration across chambers. Explicit midpoint-preserving nonnegative pairs attain both branches, while the one-leaf case maps to a spatial constant. The positive-weight optimum and complete nonexpansivity classification follow algebraically. Exact rational checker exhaustively verifies 17,736 strict-order chambers, 180 explicit attaining weighted pairs and 5,100 arbitrary two-input pairs; these support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The exact global two-input perturbation constant for a natural simultaneous median smoother on branching graphs, allowing every positive edge-variation weighting, resolves a motivated nonlinear stability question distinct from classical one-input variation smoothing. The parity jump between hub window sizes, the sharp nonexpansivity exception at three equally weighted leaves, and the unique uniform-weight minimax law describe structural phenomena with a reproducible all-degree proof, not a small isolated enumeration.
